historical_references.reference: The name Devyavesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deva' (meaning God) and 'Yavesh' (meaning invoker or summoner). This name was commonly used during ancient Hindu rituals where gods were invoked and worshipped.

Devyavesh is also mentioned in various Hindu scriptures, including the 'Mahabharata' and the 'Rigveda'. In the 'Mahabharata', Devyavesh is invoked by Arjuna during the Battle of Kurukshetra to seek divine blessings and guidance.
